supporting_span: for himself if he has attained age 65 before the close of his taxable year
for the spouse of the taxpayer if the spouse has attained age 65 before the close of the taxable year and an additional exemption is allowable to the taxpayer for such spouse under section 151(b)
for himself if he is blind at the close of the taxable year
for the spouse of the taxpayer if the spouse is blind as of the close of the taxable year and an additional exemption is allowable to the taxpayer for such spouse under section 151(b)
if the spouse dies during the taxable year the determination of whether such spouse is blind shall be made as of the time of such death
In the case of an individual who is not married and is not a surviving spouse, paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be applied by substituting "$750" for "$600".
rule: (is_individual(individual) AND NOT is_married_individual(individual) AND NOT is_surviving_spouse(individual) AND (attained_age_before_close_of_taxable_year(individual,65,taxable_year) OR is_blind_at_close_of_taxable_year(individual,taxable_year))) -> additional_standard_deduction_amount_equals(individual,750,taxable_year)
